body.prose:
A brief's paragraphs, a list in it, an image, a word that stands for something: each is a holon of its own, held by the brief, typed, and drawn by the component its type finds. Inside them is only what is not typed, values: strings of text, and the references among them. So the field holds holons and values within them, and nothing between.

*The author's, 2026-11-05: good, that leaves us with indexing; his critiques of the interior the session first proposed decided it, and the count of holons it costs is still to be measured.*
body.title: What is finer than a holon
